column2: AIRKNIF 91026 rung comments for Studio 5000 Logix Designer V32. Tools > Import > Tags and Logic Comments. If Owning Element is blank, comments match by Location (rung number). Otherwise check 'Match all ladder diagram rung comments by rung number only'. Location is the GE printout rung number (8, 11, 12, …), not a compacted 0-based index.
Each comment starts with the GE printout rung number. Printout rung comments are appended when present. Change the program/routine names below if the Airknife project uses different names.
